avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces venetoclax exposure and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; discontinue prior to venetoclax initiation

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may decrease venetoclax plasma concentrations
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; recommend alternative immune support

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin-containing supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer significantly reduces venetoclax bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Absolute contraindication; use alternative antimicrobial if needed

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition may marginally elevate venetoclax levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased toxicity; consistent dosing timing recommended

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle (Silymarin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild CYP3A4 effects; limited clinical evidence
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; inform provider of concurrent use

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein inhibition significantly increases venetoclax exposure and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Strictly avoid; counsel patient on all grapefruit products

avoid_foods.name: Pomegranate juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may elevate venetoclax concentrations

caution_foods.name: Seville oranges
caution_foods.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition; lower risk than grapefruit but similar mechanism
caution_foods.action: Minimize intake; routine orange consumption acceptable

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase venetoclax absorption and bioavailability variability
caution_foods.action: Administer with consistent food intake; counsel on uniform meal timing

monitoring_notes: Venetoclax requires CYP3A4 dosing adjustments when coadministered with strong inhibitors or inducers; monitor for tumor lysis syndrome, cytopenias, and infection. Ensure consistent food intake patterns and absolute avoidance of grapefruit and pomegranate products due to critical interaction potential.
